evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, an automatic drain that returns None is still reported as {"status":"drained"} with exit 0. That conflates a completed pass with early exits such as a clone-fetch failure or an unavailable tick lock, so JSON-only callers cannot tell that no inbox work ran. The existing JSON/exit contract expects truthful structured results; this is a concrete result-reporting defect, not a request to add a new protection scope.
